name: Artifact Schemas and CI Gates
area: Owns canonical artifacts, schema validation, CI outputs, and run-bundle plumbing bugs.
audit_basis: Matched queued BUG IDs against regression tests in tests/test_bug*.py.
Included previously merged no-op or patch-only lineage already applied in this workspace thread for BUG-013, BUG-124, BUG-135, and BUG-138.

items.title: `artifact_roundtrip.py --fix` cannot rewrite a supported direct JSON file target unless it lives under the repo `runs/` root
`validate_schemas.py` has incomplete shipped-schema coverage in both direct-file and run-directory validation modes
Repro smoke tools emit other tools' report names and schema versions, and `validate_schemas.py` blesses the mismatch as canonical
`tools/ci_gate.py` sanitizes child stdout before extracting the session run dir, so it cannot locate the run bundle it just created
`tools/artifact_roundtrip.py` ignores nested `child_runs/**/*.json` when given a run directory
`artifact_roundtrip.py --strict` can report process-level `FAIL` while leaving changed files marked `PASS`
